name: Spirits
description: Distilled rather than merely fermented — the concentrated end of the shelf.

tcm.note: Bai jiu is hot and strongly dispersing; distilled liquor is the hottest drink in the Chinese materia.

ayurveda.note: Ushna and tikshna in the highest degree of the madya group.

histamine.note: Distilling leaves most histamine behind, so clear spirits are lower than wine or beer — but the alcohol still blocks DAO, which is the bigger problem.

effects.note: Alcohol measurably slows reaction time and narrows attention at ordinary drinking doses, well before intoxication feels subjectively obvious — one of the most consistently replicated findings in pharmacology, and the reason legal drink-driving limits exist at all. Distilled rather than merely fermented, a single measure packs more alcohol by volume than the same-sized pour of beer or wine. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
